unixwin/niubash ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v1.4.3Niubash v1.4.3 Stable2026-10-21T14:10:04Z

unixwin v1.4.3 发版说明

发布形态：niubash 1.4.3（产品）携带 rubash 1.4.2（引擎，minor）。 引擎包行：如 WinuxCmd #1270 合并并发出 1.1.19，本版含 WinuxCmd 1.1.19 引擎包；已确认。

1.4.3 是一次修复与收敛为主的发布：解决控制台窗口 gather 卡死，收敛裸盘符行为，加固安装器守卫，并为 gawk LF 契约门禁铺路。建议所有 1.4.2 用户升级。

行为修复

  • console-window gather 卡死修复（rubash#955 / niubash#484）：未闭合的分组内遇到意外的关闭字符（stray close）时，引擎 reader 与产品 REPL 两侧的 gather 正确终止，不再挂死；rubash#955（engine reader 面）与 niubash#484（REPL 面）为同一缺陷的两个修位。
  • 裸盘符归一化收敛（rubash#953）：D: 与 D:/、cd D: 等裸盘符设计ator形态不再各自为政，统一收敛到引擎分发路径——同一输入在不同入口行为一致。
  • encoded-command 别名（niubash#477）：启动器（launcher）接受 -EncodedCommand / --ec 拼写，PowerShell 习惯的调用方式原样（verbatim）交接，不再被当作未知参数拒绝。

安装与升级

  • installer 守卫加固（niubash#472）：关闭 #442 守卫的残余绕过面——守卫谓词补全常量折叠、补 {sys} 名称边界，探测面更难被构造绕过。
  • gawk CRLF 门（niubash#479）：发行验证的分段 awk 管道改为对原始输出字节把关（LF 契约落地为门禁，niubash#467 的收口）。前置条件：WinuxCmd#1270（适配命令以 argv 前缀转发，gawk 退出 text mode）先行合入并随 WinuxCmd 1.1.19 发布，否则该门禁按设计红。

引擎与上游

  • bash vendored patch 20（rubash#957）：vendored third_party/bash 从 Bash-5.3 patch 15 升到 patch 20（9c465866）。含 16（macOS 动态管道尺寸）、17/18/20（readline 多字节提示词重绘与折行——CJK 场景直接相关）、19（高位字节标识符判定规避）。
  • 引擎 1.4.2：随本版携带的 rubash 1.4.2 为版本递进（metadata），引擎行为面即上述 rubash#955/#953/#957。

质量与工程

  • fd/重定向嵌套上下文审计第三轮（rubash#941）：探针 45 → 56 例，新缺陷 #934 全部面（简单命令/函数/( )/复合结构/管道/$()/持久 exec 2> 等路径的 open 失败归因）以探针钉死并记录，$0 拼写归一化使 divergences 信号重新干净——发版基线可回归。
  • clippy batch 2/3（niubash#476/#485）：niubash-runtime 清空 cloned_ref_to_slice_refs 与 chunks_exact_to_as_chunks 两批 lint（#450 并行批次），保持零告警基线。

发布链

  • 引擎钉：rubash re-pin 至 1.4.2 合并提交（scripts/release/rubash-pin.json，rubash_rev + rubash_version 同步改）。
  • 引擎包：WinuxCmd 1.1.19（v1.1.19 已随本版钉入 scripts/release/winuxcmd-pin.json，tag 与双架构 SHA256 已更新）。
  • winget：v1.4.3 资产出包后提交新 manifest PR（旧 #444854 已关闭，不在旧 PR 续作）。

完整变更清单见两仓 CHANGELOG 与各 issue/PR。tag 时点按 1.4.1/1.4.2 惯例把本稿收敛进 niubash CHANGELOG 的 ## [1.4.3] - <发布日> 小节（rubash 侧无逐版小节惯例，保持 [Unreleased] 现状）。

Yeachan-Heo/oh-my-codex ↗ 2 releases · 2 stable
v0.21.28 Stable2026-10-21T13:59:42Z

oh-my-codex v0.21.28

0.21.28 is a patch release for JetBrains terminal trackpad scrolling diagnostic (1 commit, 3 files, +167/−0; PR #3873).

Highlights

  • JetBrains trackpad scrolling diagnostic (#3873): On macOS WebStorm and other JetBrains IDE terminals, trackpad scrolling is translated to Up/Down arrow keys by the terminal emulator. When alternate screen mode is enabled, this causes the input field to be populated with previous prompts instead of scrolling the output. This release adds a startup diagnostic that detects JetBrains terminal environments and suggests the omx --no-alt-screen workaround to users on direct (non-tmux) and hotswap launches. The diagnostic is only emitted if --no-alt-screen is not already specified. Detection works by checking TERM_PROGRAM and TERMINAL_EMULATOR environment variables for JetBrains IDE indicators. Fixes #3872 (reported by @BohdanLavrinenko).

Compatibility

  • The diagnostic is informational only; no behavior changes affect existing workflows.
  • No breaking API changes; new diagnostic message is a pure UX improvement.
  • Existing sessions remain unaffected.

Validation

  • Pinned candidate 60ae8e90090f41bb52487c13cc3152c1baf05428 passed latest-per-name dev CI: 17 checks succeeded and 8 conditional checks were skipped, with no failures.
  • Release branch CI passed with all required checks green.
  • All code review findings addressed.

v0.21.27 Stable2026-10-20T20:49:08Z

oh-my-codex v0.21.27

0.21.27 is a patch release for subagents tri-state resume_agent availability (3 commits, 10 files, +317/−30; PRs #3867, #3868).

Highlights

  • SessionStart reopen guidance for hosts without resume_agent (#3867): The subagent recovery system now covers hosts that do not support the resume_agent tool, providing accurate fallback instructions instead of treating absence as unknown availability. SessionStart recovery guidance now correctly identifies unsupported hosts and recommends appropriate fallback actions.

  • Tri-state resume_agent availability tracking (#3868): The subagents contract now implements tri-state availability (available / absent / unknown) for the resume_agent tool, enabling recovery guidance to distinguish between:

    1. Available: The tool is present and usable for session recovery.
    2. Absent: The host environment does not support the tool; fallback guidance applies.
    3. Unknown: The tool availability has not yet been determined; conservative recovery behavior applies.

    This tri-state model is now wired through the native hook contract and the subagents tracker, enabling accurate recovery path selection based on host capabilities. Addresses issue #3866 (reported by ev78394).

Compatibility

  • SessionStart recovery guidance behavior changes for hosts without resume_agent; recovery now emits appropriate fallback instructions instead of treating absence as unknown.
  • Existing subagent sessions and recovery state remain compatible.
  • No breaking API changes; tri-state availability is an internal contract refinement.

Validation

  • Pinned candidate b58737f0f1eb427b978cb5561672625144616f29 passed latest-per-name dev CI: 17 checks succeeded and 8 conditional checks were skipped, with no failures.
  • Release branch CI passed with all required checks green.
  • All code review findings addressed.

NousResearch/hermes-agent ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v0.22.3Hermes Agent v0.22.3 Stable2026-10-21T12:21:11Z

Hermes Agent v0.22.3

Release Date: October 21, 2026

Patch release. This tag rolls up the ~620 PRs merged since v0.22.2 into a stable release for the CLI and installer, the Microsoft Store app, Docker and Hermes Cloud. Full curated notes for this window ship with v0.23.0.

<!-- HERMES_BUILDS_TABLE -->

About this release

Measured at commit 5b147ab036d, the window since v0.22.2 contains 2,911 non-merge commits across 4,206 changed files (+360,278 / −64,308), about 620 merged PRs and 326 closed issues.

Also in the window, undocumented here on purpose: MCP progress notifications streamed as live tool progress, a refreshed classic CLI layout (glyph transcript, status line under the composer, two-line header), OAuth clients that plugins declare and Hermes signs in and refreshes, hermes plugins update offering every available plugin update plus an Update button for git-installed plugins in Desktop, steering and editing a queued prompt from Desktop, a guided subagent model and provider picker in Desktop, a live /loop countdown row in the CLI and TUI, opt-in Telegram DM topic transfer, a post_compaction plugin hook, a capabilities catalog, the Microsoft Store build going live automatically when a release publishes, session auto-prune back to opt-in with a one-time prompt when disk runs low, Nemotron 3.5 Bolt and one-slot DFlash drafts in the local runtime, and dozens of new plugin catalog entries.

Full curated release notes for this window ship with v0.23.0, which will document everything from v0.22.0 onward — highlights, feature areas, and complete contributor credits. Nothing in this window is skipped.

Updating

  • Microsoft Store app: updates through the Store.
  • Desktop app installed from the installer (.exe / .dmg): no change in this release; it updates with the next bundled release.
  • CLI: hermes update, or re-run the installer one-liner.
  • Docker / Hermes Cloud: nousresearch/hermes-agent:stable (or :latest).

Full Changelog: v0.22.2...v0.22.3

[2.10.4]

Bug Fixes

  • 52081e04a (#16333 by @amrbashir) Rename the misspelled choowHowToInstall NSIS language string to chooseHowToInstall. A custom language file in bundle.windows.nsis.customLanguageFiles that only defines the old name keeps working for now, but users should migrate to the new name.
  • 1a02ec364 (#16330 by @lazerg) Quote the executable path in the file association shell\open\command and DefaultIcon registry values written by the NSIS installer, so opening an associated file no longer depends on how Windows splits an unquoted path that contains spaces.
  • 46b3de424 (#16335 by @amrbashir) Fixed the German NSIS installer defining the older and unknown strings under translated identifiers (älter and unbekannt), which made makensis emit warning 6040: LangString "older" is not set in language table of language German and left the version kind blank in the "An $R4 version of ... is installed on your system" prompt.
  • 46b3de424 (#16335 by @amrbashir) Fixed malformed tokens in the Italian and Swedish NSIS language files.
  • c0e3dbd91 (#16254 by @kihyun1998) Fix NSIS installers not blocking downgrades over a newer installation made by the MSI installer in silent (/S), passive (/P) and update (/UPDATE) modes when bundle.windows.allowDowngrades is false.

Dependencies

  • Upgraded to tauri-macos-sign@2.4.3
  • 4a6f51251 (#16317 by @lazerg) Updated zip to v9 to fix RUSTSEC-2026-0367, RUSTSEC-2026-0368 and RUSTSEC-2026-0369.

heygen-com/hyperframes ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v0.8.183 Stable2026-10-21T11:29:55Z

HyperFrames v0.8.183

Released on 2026-10-21.

v0.8.182 was tagged but never reached npm (its publish stopped at the package size check), so everything listed for it ships in this release.

Website capture now handles pages that reload after a cookie banner, CLI commands start faster, a repeat check starts with the CLI and Chrome already up, and snapshot and check wait for late images as render does. Renders inside a macOS sandbox no longer fail, a sharp sound at a film's start no longer grows louder with each audio pass, and lambda sites create takes source files over 5 GB. Cloud renders mix their audio beside the chunks and fail loudly when an audio read is cut off, a 4K camera shown small reaches Chrome near the size it is drawn, a finished capture exits even when a site's DNS never answers, and an unreadable frame fails a render instead of shortening it.

Features

  • AWS Lambda: A cloud render mixes its audio on its own Lambda while the chunks render, instead of before them, so a long film finishes sooner (dee8380d2, #5997).
  • Producer: A cloud plan can leave its audio out and build that track on its own, which the Lambda change above uses (8b410f1cb, #5988).
  • Registry: New echo-smear component: a streak of copies that trails an element as a GSAP timeline moves it faster (23e7a384b, #5980).

Fixes

  • CLI: Website capture waits for a page that reloads after its cookie banner closes, so assets and scroll screenshots are no longer empty (0693839b5, #4949).
  • CLI: check prints progress while it makes browser-playable copies of phone videos (b7fa007bf, #5953).
  • CLI: check, snapshot and Studio show accented and non-Latin project text correctly instead of garbled (6d357ff0d, #5843).
  • CLI: check no longer calls a film static when it moves only through an SVG mask or clip path, a stroke reveal or a canvas (0bd626825, #5960).
  • CLI: check audits a color-graded video as the video it shows, so the video's layout opt-outs apply and its footage is not read as cut-off text (9f793a6db, #5963).
  • CLI: A scoped keepsMoving check ignores a changing page background outside its scope (ba1fa8b12, #5966).
  • Lint: check and lint place each scene's audio at its host's start, so scenes that play one after another no longer warn of overlapping audio (18207de1c, #6005).
  • CLI: The Chrome the CLI launches exits with it, even when the CLI is killed (434ad8c41, #5943).
  • CLI: snapshot, compare and check wait for images that load late, as render does, so their frames show what the rendered video shows (f440db901, #5977).
  • CLI: A finished capture exits even when a site's DNS never answers, instead of staying alive until the system lookup gives up (128973477, #5983).
  • CLI: A first render on a nearly full disk refuses at once with the low-disk message instead of hanging in the browser download, and a browser download refuses up front when its disk has under 512 MB free (6cb9ce096, #6006).
  • CLI: A disk that fills while the browser download unpacks fails the install at once instead of hanging (84f796549, #6013).
  • Studio Server: On Windows, two history claims on one project at the same moment no longer crash one of them; the second waits for the lock (468467003, #5923).
  • Producer: Renders inside an agent's macOS sandbox no longer fail when reading the system uptime (26a5ab775, #5842).
  • Producer: The disk-space error suggests --workers 1 only when one worker would stream (f0ef4cb9d, #5934).
  • Producer: A render no longer publishes a shorter or smaller video than it asked for without saying why: an unreadable frame fails the encode, macOS renders keep their frames out of the project folder, and a 4K export of HDR footage is refused before Chrome starts (8942aa23b, #5978).
  • Engine: A sharp sound in a film's first moments no longer grows louder with each audio encode, so audio in renders with sound changes slightly (87c6e50f5, #5956).
  • Engine: A cloud render whose audio read from a file's link is cut off fails with an error the render retries, instead of shipping the rest of the clip silent (b4e63cf19, #5996).
  • Engine: Renders use the browser the CLI picked when both browser settings are set, and Linux renders on system Chrome no longer take the parallel capture path meant for headless-shell (0260c40e5, #5987).
  • Core: Audio volume automation stays correct when the browser refuses an overlapping curve (e44f456b7, #5927).
  • Player: An embed that sets no height shows its film at the film's shape instead of 0 px tall (46cb5ca44, #5932).
  • Inspector: Component reports show the animation code inside large wrappers and only the film's own files (bbb691001, #5989).
  • Inspector: A component report that runs out of room keeps the code that makes the animations ahead of CSS rules (41af1add0, #6003).
  • Inspector: A component report spends less of its size budget on fixed text and repeated file names, so more of the film's code fits (1d422a2fa, #6016).
  • Inspector: A component report also shows the composition and host tags that set a matched element's timing (05315a14b, #6015).
  • Catalog: Seven component previews that showed dark text on a black canvas render in their demo's theme, in the Catalog and after hyperframes add (b16d5a706, #5995).
  • AWS Lambda: lambda sites create and Lambda renders upload source files over 2 GiB and over 5 GB (c8f322c25, #5964).
  • Skills: A storyboard leaves the film as it was until the person says go, so the preview no longer plays the posed stills as a slideshow (6590d5670, #5982).

Performance

  • CLI: Commands run without loading esbuild, puppeteer-core or sharp until they need them (5583ae429, #5930).
  • CLI: Commands start sooner by compiling registry schemas on first use (d898ad89e, #5935).
  • CLI: check splits its samples over a second Chrome when a core and memory are spare (952c6ba1c, #5896).
  • CLI: A repeat check from an agent is served by a check process that already has the CLI loaded and Chrome running (434ad8c41, #5943).
  • Engine: Cloud renders take a video's audio from the stretch the edit uses, read from its link, instead of downloading the whole file (a8a80323f, #5972).
  • Producer: Local renders check the audio peak in parallel segments, as cloud plans do (e319e6449, #5942).
  • Producer: Renders the fast capture refuses keep their parallel workers instead of being pinned to one or three (30f514b13, #5945).
  • Producer: A cloud plan whose mixed audio peaks too high corrects it from the mix itself, in parallel segments, so the plan is faster and the audio closer to the mix (a125dbc19, #5981).
  • Producer: Cloud render chunks hand Chrome each video near the size it is drawn, so a 4K camera shown small no longer costs a full 4K frame on every frame (7cc5dd382, #6001).

Internal

  • Four timing tests stop failing on slow Windows runners (f98ef09be, #5949).
  • Studio's real-Chrome tests recover from a stuck Chrome launch or close (234ebc4ba, #5961).
  • Cloud download tests use small parts so a slow Windows loopback cannot time them out (852f6f9f6, #5999).
  • The Chrome orphan test waits for Chrome to exit instead of a fixed 5 s (00d55a7f1, #5986).
  • The package size check on every PR now measures what a release publishes, so a release can no longer pass review and then fail to publish on size (ccc13c3b5, #6017).
  • The generated catalog is republished (908f2d095, #5540).
  • Two lint tests that always failed on Windows now pass there (178eea563, #5579).

Full changelog

https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/compare/v0.8.181...v0.8.183

What's Changed

  • [PR] fix: no longer falsely shows "client-native compression in effect" banner on dsh restart with new ID (#3806 family, #270 | fix: dsh 重启换 id 不再误报"客户端自带压缩已落地"横幅(#3806 家族,#2709 校准) by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/3815
  • [PR] feat(pi-subagents): jump to start/end of the fleet inspector transcript by @WKBae in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/3161
  • [PR] ci: retry a shard once on the fail-0/cancelled>0 event-loop-drain shape | Windows CI 偶发假红：零断言失败仅 cancelled 的 shard 自动重跑一次 by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/3710
  • [PR] fix(ci): non-ci:full label events no longer cancel in-flight CI runs by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/3828
  • [PR] fix(#3838): high-cost plugin banner no longer warns for explicitly disabled cordis.patch.yml entries by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/3840
  • [PR] fix: mask private relay hosts in the diagnostics blob before it is pasted publicly (#3811) by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/3832
  • [PR] snapshot render: seam hardening — no silent truncation on repeated short texts (#3812) by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/3817
  • [PR] fix: alarm loudly when the dsh compaction-disable overlay cannot latch (#3806) by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/3820
  • [PR] fix: ladder off config-drifted same-lane proxies instead of failing the launch (#3801) by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/3814
  • [PR] fix: v0.1.202 review leftovers — zcode watchdog hot-retry, Responses pck ablation, pck-probe bounds, diagnostics single-read by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/3825
  • [PR] feat: dsh settings panel guides remote users to security.adminRelay (#3816) by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/3834
  • [PR] fix: carry the acp_delegate prompt as a system-prompt section so pi-claude-bridge forwards it by @WKBae in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/3822
  • [PR] fix: surface SQLite bootstrap cooldown expiry and force-retry lever in storage diagnostics by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/3790
  • [PR] Bound output-budget restore & clamp by the model's declared output ceiling (#3833) by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/3836
  • [PR] storage: default unified mode flips to full + six #3135 cleanups (#3818) by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/3819
  • [PR] fix: attribute host reasoning-effort flips to a named cache cause, not a rebuild seam (#3803) by @ranxianglei in https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/3809

stablyai/orca ↗ 4 releases · 3 stable · 1 prerelease
v1.4.237 Stable2026-10-21T07:25:23Z

100,000 stars. Thank you! ⭐🐳

Orca just crossed 100,000 stars on GitHub! Every bug report, pull request, shared workflow and recommendation has helped us get here. Thank you for building with Orca and helping shape what comes next. ❤️

To celebrate, this release brings a more capable phone experience, more dependable agent conversations, and fixes that keep your work moving across desktops and remote machines.

The short version

  • More done from your phone: Create and edit notes, save Markdown on headless hosts, follow relative file links, and see embedded images. Buffered terminal drafts can now survive workspace navigation, too.
  • Chats you can come back to: Codex chats reopen correctly after undo, Claude keeps its rewound context across Orca rollbacks, and screenshots stay with the conversation. Codex’s skill picker now reflects the skills Codex actually loaded.
  • Your work stays protected: Discard pauses autosave of the same file across workspaces. Read-only Markdown and CSV views protect your unsaved edits, and new, unstaged Markdown documents open straight into the rich editor.
  • Voice beyond the desktop: Phone dictation works again through headless orca serve hosts, with a CLI command to configure the host’s OpenAI key.
  • Smoother remote work: Reconnect hidden terminal tabs after a restart, keep browser logins when hosts pair again, and search SSH configurations with thousands of hosts without freezing the interface.
  • Small details, better flow: Phone tabs follow desktop order, landscape layouts show the session title, keyboard controls keep their height, and worktree safety sweeps skip unchanged workspaces.

Phone updates: Updating Orca on the computer serving your phone also updates the phone’s served interface. Persistent terminal drafts additionally require an updated mobile shell.

Compatibility & upgrade notes

  • Native chat (experimental): Update paired and SSH hosts alongside Orca to get the latest chat fixes. Exact Codex skill-file selection is available on desktop with a supporting host; phone selections and older hosts retain plain-text skill names. Send a skill as a new message for Codex to apply it at the start of a turn.
  • Headless dictation: Save the OpenAI key on the host doing the transcription with orca speech openai-key set (reads the key from stdin). Installed-app orca serve hosts on Linux and macOS can also use the bundled on-device recognizer; Windows, managed SSH and WSL servers use cloud models.
  • CLI launch choice: Explicit --surface choices require an updated execution host. Omitting the option keeps your existing defaults.

Product experience

Native chat (experimental)

Pick the skills Codex actually loaded, return to conversations with confidence, and keep your chat history and attachments intact.

  • Use Codex’s own loaded-skill catalog in chat; desktop selections identify the exact skill file, including when names overlap by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30937
  • Reopen Codex chats after undo and continue with the correct conversation history by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31041
  • Keep Claude’s rewound context intact even after rolling back Orca by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31231
  • Show prompts sent mid-turn and ! commands where Claude actually received them by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31204
  • Keep screenshots dragged into a chat available for the lifetime of that chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30419
  • Retry failed chat names, show naming errors on the tab hover card, and offer Regenerate name by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30646
  • Keep resumed Claude chats ready to receive messages after settings updates by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30982
  • Show Working only while Claude, Pi or ACP is handling work, while keeping Claude chat workers running by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30577
  • Show sleeping native-chat workspaces as asleep and hide them when the sidebar filter calls for it by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28457
  • Tie finished notifications to the correct hook-driven turn by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30620
  • Clarify how to continue conversations between chat and terminal agents by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31402

Phone

Move between workspaces without losing your draft, work on Markdown without an open desktop window, and enjoy a more consistent interface.

v1.4.235 Stable2026-10-20T22:52:23Z

Thank you so much for using Orca and for your continued support! ❤️

This release makes conversations easier to revisit, keeps more of your agent's work, and cuts background editor activity when you're juggling workspaces.

The short version

  • Rewind Claude chats: Use Rewind to here on a message that started a turn, edit your prompt, and take the conversation in a new direction. Claude continues from the history you kept.
  • Your chat, your settings: Each conversation remembers its own model, effort and Fast settings. Switching models keeps compatible choices, and changes to an agent's defaults no longer silently move a chat that has recorded its settings.
  • Keep more of your agent's work: Completed replies and tool results are saved in full rather than cut off at the preview limit. Use Show full output on desktop or phone, or Show full message on phone, to load more content from shortened previews.
  • Less waiting, less background work: New Chat opens the composer immediately, Codex chats get the time they need to start, and the workspace jump palette is preloaded. The editor watches active, recent and at-risk workspaces instead of every workspace with an open tab.
  • A better phone experience: Live chats reconnect from where they left off, project groups stay in step with desktop, and ready cloud dictation models can be selected from the phone. Workspace creation starts preparing the checkout while you fill in the form.
  • Everyday polish: Edit images in queued desktop messages, see machine labels only when project names collide, and get more reliable workspace lists, file-conflict handling and remote workflows.

Phone updates: Updating Orca on your desktop also updates the app on your connected phone—the phone loads it directly from your desktop.

Compatibility & upgrade notes

Native chat (experimental): Keep paired and SSH hosts updated alongside Orca for the latest chat features. Full-content loading requires host support; content discarded by older versions cannot be recovered. Very large items may still be shortened for display or delivery.

Cloud dictation: Select a ready cloud model from the phone's dictation setup or Settings → Voice. Configure its API key on the computer serving the phone first.

Product experience

Native chat (experimental)

Revisit Claude conversations, keep each chat’s settings consistent, and work with images and long outputs more comfortably.

  • Rewind Claude chats from messages that started a turn, continuing with the conversation you kept by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30400
  • Remember model, effort, speed and Fast choices per conversation, including across restarts by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30561
  • Save completed replies and tool results in full, with controls to load more from shortened previews by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29982
  • Edit images in queued desktop messages: remove, paste, drop or attach by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30815
  • Open the New Chat composer immediately while the host gets ready by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29358
  • Wait for Codex when opening or resuming a chat instead of failing after 30 seconds by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30395
  • Name chats from the first message immediately, even if automatic title generation fails by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30392
  • Avoid starting user MCP servers and hooks for background Claude runs by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30939
  • Clarify labels for switching agents between terminal and chat by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31134
  • Polish the appearance of chat question options by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31219

Phone

Keep conversations and project groups current, create workspaces with less waiting, and select cloud dictation models directly from your phone.

  • Keep session tab icons full size beside long titles by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31169

Editor, performance & file safety

Reduce background file watching, speed up workspace navigation, and make reloads and save conflicts more dependable across tabs and devices.

  • Watch active, recent and at-risk workspaces; refresh open files when you return to an unwatched workspace by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30415

  • Improve save-conflict checks, Undo after reload, autosave during heavy file activity and chat-start error messages by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31216
  • Release superseded and closed editor-tab watch probes and disk-check records by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31128
  • Avoid reapplying terminal bindings that already match when saving state by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31033

Workspaces, SSH & remote servers

Keep workspace lists current, make same-named projects easier to distinguish, and improve remote server transitions and permissions.

  • Show machine labels only when projects have the same name by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31233

Settings & security

Keep Experimental settings accessible after language updates and tighten permissions for newly created Codex configuration files.

  • Prevent Experimental settings from crashing after language-pack updates by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31202

Relay service

Tests, CI & maintenance

v1.4.233 Stable2026-10-20T18:27:32Z

Thank you so much for using Orca and for your continued support! ❤️

We shipped two releases today! If you missed it, check out the v1.4.232 release notes too. Highlights include Manual / Auto / Yolo agent permissions, OpenCode 2 in native chat, a better phone composer with file attachments and inline skills, smoother SSH recovery, and a smaller app with faster Mac updates.

Phone updates: Updating Orca on your desktop also updates the app on your connected phone—the phone loads it directly from your desktop.

The short version

  • SSH & remote workspaces: Connecting to an SSH host works when neither machine can download Node.js, with a one-click mirror Orca remembers and retries. Older Windows hosts (Windows 10 1809 and Server 2019) can run Orca's server, and tunnels recover when a port is held by an old SSH connection.
  • Remote servers in Settings: Remote Orca Servers is one list instead of six sections, and SSH hosts can be removed in bulk and stay removed. Orca tells you when the same server was saved twice, and adding a server you already saved updates it instead.
  • Phone: Creating a workspace from the phone is much faster, the workspace list stays in step with the desktop, and session tab icons keep their size beside long titles.
  • Editor: Orca refuses to save over changes made to a file on disk that you haven't seen, and Reload and Undo behave predictably afterwards.
  • Everyday polish: Projects with the same name on different machines keep short names and show which machine they're on. Long saved conversations use far less memory when Orca scans them for Session History.

Product experience

SSH, managed servers & remote

SSH hosts connect in more situations, Remote Orca Servers is one clear list, and edits always go to the machine that owns the workspace.

  • One-click Node.js mirror when neither machine can download Node by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31069
  • Retry with the saved Node.js mirror once a running connect fails the same way by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31089
  • Ship node-pty's winpty backend so Windows 1809 / Server 2019 hosts can deploy by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31056
  • A managed tunnel whose forward can't start takes the stdio bridge, and reclaims a port an old ControlMaster holds by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31062
  • A legacy relay restarted at the same socket never takes over an open tab by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31068
  • Detect Linux libraries reliably across SSH and WSL by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31077
  • Remote Orca Servers: one list instead of six sections; SSH Hosts: bulk remove that stays removed by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31082
  • Adding a server you already saved updates it instead of saving it twice by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31080
  • Say which saved servers are the same machine paired twice, and how to fix it by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31100
  • Say "Orca on <host>" instead of "managed server" in the UI by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31099
  • A moved SSH host lists once in a project's Available Hosts by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31064
  • New local projects never dedupe onto an SSH project at the same path by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31055
  • PR/MR worktree base refuses SSH projects named only by executionHostId by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31054
  • Worktree create sends the host --project/--host selected by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31066
  • Editor writes and unqualified removals route by the rows, never the Active Server focus by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31036
  • No owner route reads the Active Server focus, so a local row never routes to the focused server by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31058
  • A damaged browser file list disables only the browser client, not the remote server by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31025
  • A live orcad's browser helper pauses for macOS desktop installs by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31059

Phone

Create workspaces from the phone much faster, and keep the phone's workspace list and session tabs accurate.

  • Prepare the worktree checkout while the new-workspace form is open by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31167
  • Phone list resends lost option changes, trusts the feed's row facts, and retries a failed feed read by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31088
  • Keep session tab icons full size beside long titles by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31169

Workspaces, sidebar & tabs

Same-named projects on different machines are easy to tell apart, and the sidebar's agent status and visibility settings stay accurate.

  • Keep project names short and show their machine by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28250
  • One agent phase history, so a compaction raises no unread and a title-started turn pushes its finish by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31103
  • Visibility settings refresh workspace rows; pre-gap paired-server answers stay unverifiable by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31106

Editor, files & Markdown

Saving no longer overwrites changes made on disk behind your back, and previews and renames act on the right file.

  • Refuse saves that would overwrite unnoticed disk changes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30417
  • Disk-checked save follow-ups: repeatable stale reloads, Markdown whitespace, Undo of Reload by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31113
  • Markdown preview of a terminal-opened file reads with its source tab's grant by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31060
  • A rename retargets only editors whose own owner is the renaming host by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31091

Browser

Browser screenshots from an SSH host are checked when they're taken and when they're answered.

  • An SSH host's capture is admitted at each capture and at its answer by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31072

Performance & reliability

Long saved conversations no longer take several times their size in memory while Orca indexes them.

  • [mem] Stream saved transcripts and stage large search writes by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30702

Relay service

The hosted relay keeps desktops in their own region and spreads traffic evenly while it is updated.

  • Give region-correction reconnects and roll re-placements the in-region reserve fallback by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31042
  • Move director traffic in two steps so a deploy does not land on one instance by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31051
  • Let the same-cap trust probe outlast load-balancer warm-up by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31067

Tests, CI & maintenance

Faster, lighter builds and checks; the new layout and sidebar work remains behind disabled build switches.

  • Run cell-flags and reserve-watch on the paid runner pool by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31024
  • Keep Mac qualification runs out of the release build's concurrency group by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31031
  • Build Windows alongside Mac and preserve signing quota by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31032
  • Cut end-to-end typecheck memory with Bun by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31046
  • Halve CLI compile memory with Bun typechecking by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31043
  • Stop the cold-authority scope test depending on the clock by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31098
  • Shared switch-on fixtures so 71 layout tests pass with main owning the layout by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31076
  • A test-only switch-on server template that packaging refuses by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31097
  • No empty extra terminal tab from an old saved terminal record (dark, layout-owner build only) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31045
  • Agent titles from one status batch reach main as one rename (dark, layout-owner build only) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31048
  • Main sends one layout update per action, with only what changed (dark, layout-owner build only) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31109
  • Same-id workspaces on two hosts sort, nest and stay retained on their own; nested groups and project order hold in host sections (dark switch) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31111
  • A read Done no longer hides a pane that is still Working in Smart (dark switch) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31114
  • Update WeChat QR code for group 13 by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31052

v2026.10.10-beta.3openclaw 2026.10.10-beta.3 Prerelease2026-10-21T07:00:49Z

2026.10.10-beta.3

Highlights

  • Windows reliability: restore fresh state initialization and Gateway startup, hide SQLite helper windows during app updates, and make forced Gateway reinstalls tolerate launcher timestamp settling. (#176194, #174969, #176174, #176945; related #176111, #174906, #176163, and #176872) Thanks @skyzhao1223, @RomneyDa, @easyteacher, @throwingbones, @tjarrau-dev, and @cnnceart.
  • Upgrade recovery: converge app-owned plugins to the upgraded core version, restore affected agent stores including held system agents after schema-changing updates, and scope migration rollback backups to the versioned tables being changed. (#174257, #175007, #176783, #172671; related #174120 and #176669) Thanks @RomneyDa, @kazuyuki-eguchi, and @PennyVibe.

Changes

Fixes

  • Agent state: concurrent initialization can no longer let two agents claim ownership of the same agent database. (#174251)
  • Codex and native apps: previews no longer block replies after a context refresh, session replies resume after native child recovery, bound Codex history survives app-server restarts, and native app messages send again after reconnecting. (#177716, #177564, #172705, #171528) Thanks @jjjhenriksen and @RomneyDa.
  • Background tasks: completions are no longer dropped when the config changes mid-turn. (#169529; related #169054) Thanks @wangmiao0668000666, @RomneyDa, and @Oldrich333.
  • Discord: restore native slash commands in channels and threads. Thanks @montrellcruse and @RomneyDa.
  • Agents: keep the prompt cache when a rate-limited run retries, and preserve steering messages that arrive without an explicit target. Thanks @montrellcruse, @RomneyDa, and @obviyus.
  • Cron/CLI continuity: preserve CLI chat sessions across cron announce wakes instead of resetting their provider session. (#176218; related #176208) Thanks @eliavb43 and @RomneyDa.
  • CLI tools: invalidate reused CLI sessions when the available tool catalog changes, restoring tools such as exec after Gateway restarts and preventing stale catalogs from reaching spawned agents. (#176577; related #175670) Thanks @RomneyDa, @jackylecalvez2, and @vincentkoc.
  • GMI: omit unsupported reasoning_effort values on GPT-5.6 tool turns so the provider no longer rejects them with HTTP 400. (#176709) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Windows updates: recognize Scheduled Task permission denials in every Windows display language, keep Windows plugin dependency links across Doctor phases, and clean up backup scratch directories without EPERM failures. (#178624, #178219, #169672, #176836; related #176743) Thanks @RomneyDa, @n572770, @xutongxue233, and @WG-Mojo.
  • Update and Doctor: update finalization honors TMPDIR for disposable copies, Doctor suggests a retry instead of a restore after snapshot contention, and repeated Docker container restarts no longer take a full Doctor pre-repair capture each time. (#178009, #176779, #173711; related #176750 and #173564) Thanks @RomneyDa, @WG-Mojo, and @8bitsforge.
  • Memory: cold Gateway starts no longer open every memory index (restoring 2026.10.4 startup memory), memory files keep indexing after plugin reloads, and plugin reloads no longer time out during slow dreaming cleanup. (#174718, #167756, #169945) Thanks @RomneyDa and @Stronggenetics.
  • Nodes: synchronous node exec output is no longer repeated as a separate Exec finished wake after the waiting caller already received it. (#164511) Thanks @holgergruenhagen and @obviyus.
  • macOS: long exec commands through the macOS app node no longer fail after 20 seconds. (#172117; related #139706) Thanks @holgergruenhagen, @RomneyDa, @ylcn91, and @Colton-Harris.
  • Control UI: offer desktop setup instead of Retry when Host Desktop is off, model pickers refresh when the catalog changes mid-read, and locale refresh works again after adding a source-only locale. (#177888, #174812, #172689; related #174368) Thanks @etzelm, @RomneyDa, and @hannesrudolph.

Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.10.10-beta.2..bd1a53a3a5f59a8319112250b48d338d74dbaceb history: 53 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 53 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v1.3.9 Stable2026-10-21T06:54:32Z

English | 中文

<h2 id="en-v1.3.9">Highlights</h2>

  • Added official mpt pip packaging. Start the WebUI with mpt webui or generate videos with mpt cli.
  • Added static and slow zoom image effects for local and AI-generated images. Slow zoom remains the default.
  • Added Kimi Code subscription access with browser authorization, alongside improvements to the sign-in dialog, status updates, and cancellation.
  • Added an optional local SDXL image server for the OpenAI-compatible image material workflow, with idle GPU offloading.
  • Added Opper, onomeo, Muse Spark, and EmpirioLabs AI LLM providers, and completed Brazilian Portuguese WebUI translations.
  • Added diagnostic logging controls in the WebUI, including runtime log-level changes and opt-in API request tracing with redaction and size limits.

Fixes and Improvements

  • Fixed grayscale image brightness, transparent image backgrounds, zoom mask alignment, and subtitle background colors. Improved transitions on short clips, background music fade-out, and special-character handling in concatenation paths.
  • Isolated intermediate image files across concurrent jobs, improved image cache identity, and validated cached downloads. Completed videos are retained when another video in the same batch fails.
  • Fixed speech speed, volume, and audio container handling across several providers. Improved remote audio validation and preserved existing audio until replacement output is ready.
  • Improved subtitle timestamp rounding, long-word wrapping, Unicode handling, and pause-tag recognition. Symbol-only lines and separators no longer distort estimated subtitle alignment.
  • Fixed Chinese and Japanese fallback social titles using the entire script. Improved JSON extraction, reasoning removal, Markdown cleanup, and generated search-term validation.
  • Expanded supported local upload formats, including multi-picture camera JPEGs. Improved task history checks, deletion state, subtitle previews, and model connection error messages in the WebUI.
  • Added HEAD support for generated artifacts and improved byte-range downloads, validation errors, and Redis task updates and deletion safeguards.
  • Reduced unsafe speech resubmissions after lost responses or redirects, preserved Upload-Post tracking handles, and improved WaveSpeed submission error detection.
  • Updated Edge TTS to address 403 failures, constrained PyAV for Whisper compatibility, and fixed Windows cache cleanup and UTF-8 BOM handling in locale files.
  • Improved the agent helper's configuration handling and preflight checks, including workflows with prepared narration and visuals that do not need an LLM.

What's Changed

  • Official pip package with WebUI and CLI launchers — c3634de.
  • Static and slow zoom image options — 90f7701.
  • Kimi Code subscription provider — @ysntony in #1599, followed by sign-in flow improvements.
  • Local SDXL image server — @imkashif in #1668.
  • Opper LLM provider — @Felixkw12 in #1589.
  • onomeo LLM provider — @Owaid0723666 in #1600.
  • Muse Spark provider and Brazilian Portuguese translations — @humbertocortezia in #1657.
  • EmpirioLabs AI provider — @Adam-Dalloul in #1694.
  • Runtime diagnostic logging and request tracing — 6940611.
  • Chinese and Japanese fallback social titles — e25326e.
  • Retained completed videos after batch failures — @hdu-r3drum in #1597.
  • Edge TTS 403 fix — @HEOJUNFO in #1652.
  • Whisper/PyAV compatibility — @cristianchiriac in #1582.
  • Windows cache cleanup — @shan3520 in #1654.
  • UTF-8 BOM locale support — @ketpatil77 in #1658.
  • Task protection for unparseable states — @RerankerGuo in #1663.
  • Clearer model connection errors — @fengqiaoqu in #1645.
  • Local material preflight checks — @drakeo338 in #1585; preserved Redis task IDs — @ac1982 in #1588.
  • Grayscale rendering, artifact HEAD requests, and prepared-media agent workflows — @rudycelekli in #1620, #1636, and #1608, alongside many subtitle, speech, material, API, and task reliability fixes.

Thanks to all contributors and everyone who reported issues and helped test these changes!

Full Changelog: v1.3.8...v1.3.9

<h2 id="cn-v1.3.9">重点更新</h2>

  • 支持通过 pip 安装官方 mpt 包，使用 mpt webui 启动界面，或通过 mpt cli 生成视频。
  • 新增图片动态效果选项，本地图片和 AI 生成图片均可选择“静止”或“缓慢放大”，默认保留缓慢放大。
  • 新增 Kimi Code 订阅接入，支持浏览器授权登录，并优化登录窗口布局、状态更新和取消操作。
  • 新增可选的本地 SDXL 生图服务，通过 OpenAI 兼容接口接入图片素材生成，支持空闲时释放 GPU 显存。
  • 新增 Opper、onomeo、Muse Spark 和 EmpirioLabs AI 大模型服务，完善巴西葡萄牙语界面翻译。
  • 新增诊断日志设置，支持在 WebUI 中即时调整日志等级，按需记录经过脱敏和长度限制的 API 请求参数。

修复与改进

  • 修复灰度图片亮度、透明图片背景、缩放蒙版对齐和字幕背景颜色问题；改善短片段转场、背景音乐淡出和拼接路径中的特殊字符处理。
  • 隔离并发任务的图片中间文件，改善图片缓存标识并校验下载缓存；批量生成部分失败时，保留已经完成的视频。
  • 修复部分配音服务的语速、音量和音频格式处理，完善远程音频校验；替换音频准备完成前保留已有文件。
  • 改善字幕时间戳舍入、长词换行、Unicode 字符和停顿标签识别，避免纯符号行和分隔线干扰字幕时间轴估算。
  • 修复中文、日文备用社交标题使用整篇脚本的问题；改善 JSON 提取、推理内容过滤、Markdown 文案清理和素材搜索词校验。
  • 补齐支持的本地上传格式，包括多图相机 JPEG；改善 WebUI 历史视频检查、任务删除状态、字幕预览和模型连接错误提示。
  • 支持生成文件的 HEAD 请求，完善范围下载、参数错误提示，以及 Redis 任务状态更新和删除保护。
  • 减少语音请求在响应丢失或重定向后被重复提交的风险，保留 Upload-Post 请求追踪信息，并改善 WaveSpeed 提交失败的识别。
  • 更新 Edge TTS，修复相关 403 问题；限制 PyAV 版本以兼容 Whisper，修复 Windows 缓存清理和带 UTF-8 BOM 的翻译文件读取。
  • 改善 Agent 辅助脚本的配置处理和启动检查，已准备好配音与画面的任务不再额外要求大模型服务。

主要变更

  • c3634de：官方 pip 安装包与 WebUI、CLI 启动命令。
  • 90f7701：图片静止与缓慢放大选项。
  • #1599：Kimi Code 订阅接入，感谢 @ysntony；后续补充了登录流程优化。
  • #1668：本地 SDXL 生图服务，感谢 @imkashif。
  • #1589：Opper 大模型服务，感谢 @Felixkw12。
  • #1600：onomeo 大模型服务，感谢 @Owaid0723666。
  • #1657：Muse Spark 大模型服务与巴西葡萄牙语翻译，感谢 @humbertocortezia。
  • #1694：EmpirioLabs AI 大模型服务，感谢 @Adam-Dalloul。
  • 6940611：运行时诊断日志设置与请求追踪。
  • e25326e：中文、日文备用社交标题修复。
  • #1597：批量生成失败后保留已完成的视频，感谢 @hdu-r3drum。
  • #1652：Edge TTS 403 修复，感谢 @HEOJUNFO。
  • #1582：Whisper 与 PyAV 兼容性修复，感谢 @cristianchiriac。
  • #1654：Windows 缓存清理修复，感谢 @shan3520。
  • #1658：带 UTF-8 BOM 的翻译文件支持，感谢 @ketpatil77。
  • #1663：状态无法解析时的任务保护，感谢 @RerankerGuo。

Desktop 3 · CLI 3

桌面端更新

重点内容

  • [Desktop · CLI] Go 工具链升级到 1.26.10，修复证书验证对不再受信任的中间证书的处理 — Go 1.26.10 修复了标准库 crypto/x509 的证书验证：遇到已知的、不再受信任的中间证书时会报错（GO-2026-6809）。Reasonix 已用它重新构建；升级之后，漏洞扫描没有再报出 Reasonix 可达的漏洞。 (#14051 by @esengine)
  • [Desktop · CLI] OpenCode Go 连接改用官方文档里的接口地址，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 也能正常使用 — OpenCode Go 文档里新的推理接口地址和 deepseek-v4.1-flash 之前没有收录，所以 V4.1 Flash 连接可能丢失 DeepSeek 的思考和工具历史回放，新地址也缺少 Go 的客户端请求头和模型发现。现在都已支持，旧的路径继续可用。已保存的标准 OpenCode Go 连接会一次性更新，保留你选的模型、凭据引用、价格和自定义字段，并给符合条件的连接添加一次 V4.1 Flash（你删掉的模型不会被加回来）；带自定义请求地址或请求体的连接留给你自己检查。 (#14029 by @SivanCola)

studio-v2.47.1Reasonix Studio v2.47.1 Stable2026-10-21T04:10:31Z

本版用 Go 1.26.10 重新构建，修复标准库证书验证对已不再受信任的中间证书的处理，并修好历史搜索读不到会话时误报“没有匹配”和多进程下会话从搜索里消失的问题。

修复

  • 构建改用 Go 1.26.10，修复标准库证书验证 crypto/x509 对已不再受信任的中间证书的处理（GO-2026-6809）。关联 #14034。
  • 会话记录读不出来时，历史搜索不再说「没有匹配」，而是先提示索引不完整，并把该会话标为损坏、稍后自动重试。关联 #14023 by @chuiwenwei。
  • 两个进程共用一个历史索引时，另一个进程刚索引的会话不再被误判为「已删除」而从历史搜索里消失；只有确认文件不存在才会被标记缺失。关联 #14024 by @chuiwenwei。
  • 侧栏“项目”标题行里的“+”和“更多操作”按钮悬停时现在是同一种高亮。关联 #14041 fixed in #14043 by @lancy69、#14043 by @lancy69。

贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@chuiwenwei、@lancy69

<!-- lang:en -->

This release is rebuilt with Go 1.26.10, which fixes how certificate verification treats intermediate certificates that are no longer trusted, and fixes history search reporting no match for an unreadable transcript or losing a session another process had just indexed.

Fixed

  • builds now use Go 1.26.10, which fixes how crypto/x509 certificate verification treats intermediate certificates that are no longer trusted (GO-2026-6809). Refs #14034.
  • when a session's transcript cannot be read, history search no longer claims a miss; it says the index is incomplete, marks that session corrupt, and retries on the next scan. Refs #14023 by @chuiwenwei.
  • with two processes sharing one history index, a conversation the other process just indexed is no longer swept as deleted; only a file confirmed gone is marked missing. Refs #14024 by @chuiwenwei.
  • The sidebar's Projects header now highlights the "+" and more-actions buttons the same way on hover. Refs #14041 fixed in #14043 by @lancy69, #14043 by @lancy69.

Contributors

Thanks to this release's contributors: @chuiwenwei, @lancy69

What's Changed

  • fix(studio): unify project header button highlights by @lancy69 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14043
  • fix(history): an unreadable transcript is a corrupt source, not no results by @chuiwenwei in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14023
  • fix(history): a scan must confirm absence before it marks a source missing by @chuiwenwei in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14024
  • build: use Go 1.26.10 for the crypto/x509 fix (GO-2026-6809) by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14050
  • docs(release): studio 2.47.1 notes by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14057

Full Changelog: https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/compare/studio-v2.47.0...studio-v2.47.1

macOS 已用 Developer ID 签名并公证，打开时不需要清除隔离属性。Windows 的窗口、内核与安装器都经 Certum 代码签名证书做了 Authenticode 签名。Linux Debian 系从 .deb 安装，Fedora、RHEL、openSUSE 等从 .rpm 安装（sudo dnf install ./ReasonixStudio-linux-amd64.rpm）。x86_64 用文件名带 amd64 的包，aarch64（统信 UOS、麒麟等）用带 arm64 的包。也提供 .AppImage（只提供下载，不会自更新；需要 FUSE 2，或用 --appimage-extract-and-run 启动）。

三个平台都能自更新：Linux 的 .deb 走自己的包（.rpm 的自更新尚未提供，请手动下载新包），Windows 运行下一个安装器，macOS 替换自身 bundle。

studio-v2.47.0Reasonix Studio v2.47.0 Stable2026-10-21T02:17:14Z

本版新增默认关闭的 Windows 命令沙箱、定时运行、外部文字确认开关，以及工作台里 PDF、CSV 和静态 HTML 的预览（AI 文件交付卡片需在用户配置里主动启用），并修复长会话窗口内存上涨、1.x 会话导入与历史搜索、自定义预设切换过慢等一批问题。

新增

  • 设置 → 自动化 → 定时运行：查看、预览确认后创建、暂停、续期、删除定时任务，并查看每次运行的结果。关联 #11406。
  • Windows 命令沙箱（设置 > 沙箱，默认关）：不能在授权文件夹外创建或改写文件；删除、重命名、读取、联网、ssh-agent/docker 管道不受限。见 #13109。
  • 设置的「工具与权限」里有「外部文字」开关，开启后照抄网页或工具结果文字的调用，Auto 和 YOLO 也先问你；默认关。关联 #13111。
  • 配置项 permissions.ask_on_external_origin（默认关）：调用逐字复制了网页或工具结果里的文字时，Auto 和 YOLO 也先问你。见 #13111。
  • 远程机器现在可以在侧栏里上移、下移（远程项目菜单里的“上移/下移 机器名”），整台机器连同它的项目一起移动。关联 #13958。
  • 会话右键菜单有「标为已读」，未读的会话（本机或远端）不用打开就能清掉未读标记。关联 #13962。
  • 打开有未读回答的会话时，在新回答开始的位置画一条分隔线；可在设置的外观里关闭。关联 #13962。
  • 用户配置 tools.present_files 主动启用 AI 交付卡片；工作台直接预览 Markdown、图片、PDF、CSV/TSV 和静态 HTML。关联 #14031 by @SivanCola。
  • 终端的会话选择器（/resume）里按 Ctrl+D 询问、对同一行再按一次 Ctrl+D 才永久删除该会话；当前打开的会话会被拒绝并说明原因。见 #13954。

变更

  • 会话很长时，折叠或展开左侧会话栏不再逐帧重算整段对话的样式，动画明显更顺。关联 #13936 fixed in #13937。
  • Agent 预设编辑器的“添加模块”下拉在名称旁显示工具、技能或命令自己的一行说明，下拉箭头和“添加模块”按钮的间距也调开了。关联 #13964。
  • 交付卡片适配宽窄布局，提供文件类型图标、当前预览标记和“更多”操作；聊天及工作台图标增加统一提示。关联 #14031 by @SivanCola。
  • 工作台打开 HTML 默认使用不执行脚本的静态预览；本地桌面需点击“交互运行”才能运行页面。关联 #14031 by @SivanCola。

修复

  • 启动较慢时，等待窗口说明正在等待本地服务就绪，不再让普通重启看起来像首次安装。启动和关闭到托盘的行为不变。关联 #13352。
  • 已完成的工具调用的输出不再被拆成逐行页面节点，调用多的长会话里窗口内存不再因此上涨，外观不变。关联 #13899。
  • 恢复旧会话时，1.x 桌面端的会话按各自记录的工作目录归到各自项目，不再整库倒进所选项目；没有记录归属的留在原处并列为未导入。见 #13920 fixed in #13921 and #13970。
  • 项目里有大量 1.x 旧会话时，每次展开项目都要把它们逐个重放，列表要等几分钟；现在重放一次后记住结果。关联 #13950。
  • 用 ! 直接运行命令时，现在和模型的 bash 工具一样能找到终端里装的工具（读取登录 shell 的 PATH），不再报“command not found”。关联 #13956。
  • 侧栏里运行中的会话行，行首不再出现“圆点叠在竖线上”的两个重叠形状，标题也不再比其他行多缩进一格。关联 #13960 fixed in #13963。
  • 会话列表比窗格晚加载时，正在前台的会话仍显示未读圆点，现在窗口有焦点时会自动标为已看。关联 #13962。
  • 写入落在「额外可写入范围」等工作区之外的文件时，不再占住整个工作区，别的会话写项目文件不会被卡住；只有同一路径的写入互相等待。关联 #13965。
  • 连接 WSL 后，含空格的 IPv6 区域名被写进已知主机文件，之后所有远程连接都读不了它；现在不再写区域名，并跳过已损坏的行、给出警告。关联 #13967 fixed in #13992。
  • 在不属于任何版本库的文件夹里，只改文档的交付任务不再被要求补一次根本跑不通的检查，也不再每轮重复同一条验证提示。关联 #13971 fixed in #13983。
  • 侧栏里当前会话的行与悬停行、普通行几乎分不出来，现在选中行有更深的底色和一圈细轮廓，悬停不会盖掉它。关联 #13972 fixed in #13975。
  • 输入框下方的 Git 指示和相邻的 Agent、询问等控件字号、行高一致，放大界面文字后也不再错位。关联 #13982 fixed in #14000 by @lancy69。
  • Studio 计算机操作功能首次启动或中断后重启时，会等待驱动就绪，避免偶发启动失败。关联 #13985 by @SivanCola。
  • 服务器拒绝 sftp（如群晖 NAS）时，远程目录选择、连接和 remote test 改用普通命令通道；见 #13981、#13987。
  • Agent 预设提示「组合所需资源不可用」时，现在会写明是哪个模块（如 tools:xxx）以及原因，不再只显示一句笼统的话。关联 #13988。
  • 点过聊天里的文件链接并关掉那个文件后，再点侧栏「文件」会重新打开它，而不是显示文件树。关联 #13993。
  • 会话历史搜索只索引「用户说过的话」，不再把宿主前置的语言、日期、项目说明等块写进索引，因此这些块里的词不会再出现「命中却看不到出处」。关联 #14022 by @chuiwenwei。
  • 文档删除或撤销访问后不再保留过期的已保存正文；未保存编辑仍会保留，元数据检查不再随每次按键重复触发。关联 #14031 by @SivanCola。
  • 新建自定义预设会话按需加载技能和扩展、连接 MCP，不再生成全量快照。继承模式跟随当前已授权配置。关联 #13988。

升级须知

  • 升级后首次启动会重建一次历史索引。关联 #14022 by @chuiwenwei。
  • 已有快照会话保持原行为。新会话使用事件 schema 5、归档 version 3，旧客户端不能继续执行；升级后仍可读取旧会话。关联 #13988。

贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@SivanCola、@lancy69、@chuiwenwei

<!-- lang:en -->

This release adds an opt-in Windows command sandbox, scheduled runs, an external-text confirmation switch and workbench previews for PDF, CSV and static HTML, and fixes window memory growth in long sessions, 1.x session import and history search.

New

  • Settings, Automation, Scheduled runs: list, create after a confirmed preview, pause, renew and delete scheduled tasks, and read each run's result. Refs #11406.
  • a Windows command sandbox (Settings > Sandbox, off): no creating or overwriting files outside granted folders; delete, rename, read, network, ssh-agent/docker pipes are not bounded. #13109
  • Settings > Tools has an "Outside text" switch: when on, a call that copies text from a web page or tool result asks first, even in Auto and YOLO. Off by default. Refs #13111.
  • permissions.ask_on_external_origin (off by default): Auto and YOLO ask first when a call copies text verbatim from a web page or tool result. See #13111.
  • Remote machines can now be moved up and down in the sidebar (the remote project menu's "Move <machine> up/down"), taking their projects with them. Refs #13958.
  • the session context menu has "Mark as read", which clears the unread mark of a local or remote conversation without opening it. Refs #13962.
  • opening a session with unread answers draws a line where they begin; it can be turned off in Settings, Appearance. Refs #13962.
  • user-only tools.present_files opts into AI delivery cards; the workbench previews Markdown, images, PDF, CSV/TSV and static HTML. Refs #14031 by @SivanCola.
  • In the terminal's session picker (/resume), Ctrl+D asks and a second Ctrl+D on the same row erases that conversation for good; the open session is refused with the reason. See #13954.

Changed

  • folding or opening the left rail with a long conversation no longer restyles the whole transcript on every frame, so the animation stays smooth. Refs #13936 fixed in #13937.
  • the preset editor's add-module menu shows each tool, skill or command's own one-line description, and the arrow and button spacing are less cramped. Refs #13964.
  • responsive delivery cards have type icons, current-file markers and More actions; chat and workbench icons share accessible tooltips. Refs #14031 by @SivanCola.
  • HTML opens as a script-free static preview by default; on desktop, select Interactive run to execute the page. Refs #14031 by @SivanCola.

Fixed

  • a slow launch says it is waiting for the local service, rather than making an ordinary relaunch look like a first installation. Startup and close-to-tray behaviour are unchanged. Refs #13352.
  • a finished tool call's output is no longer split into one page node per line, which inflated window memory in long sessions with many calls; it looks the same. Refs #13899.
  • recovering older sessions files each 1.x Desktop conversation under the project its own header records, not all under the one picked; one with none is left and listed. See #13920 fixed in #13921 and #13970.
  • a project holding many 1.x conversations replayed each of them on every listing, so the list took minutes; the result is now remembered after the first replay. Refs #13950.
  • Commands run with ! now find the tools your terminal finds (the login shell's PATH), like the model's bash tool, instead of "command not found". Refs #13956.
  • a running session row in the sidebar no longer draws a status dot on top of its state bar, and its title no longer sits one step further right than the other rows. Refs #13960 fixed in #13963.
  • a session already in front kept its unread dot when the session list arrived after the pane; it is now marked seen as soon as the window has focus. Refs #13962.
  • writing a file outside the workspace, such as in an extra writable folder, no longer claims the whole workspace; only writes to the same path wait on each other. Refs #13965.
  • an IPv6 zone with spaces was written to the managed known_hosts file and broke later remote connections; zones are no longer written, broken lines are skipped with a warning. Refs #13967 fixed in #13992.
  • a Delivery task that only edits documents outside any repository is no longer asked for a check that cannot run there, and a verification debt is explained once. Refs #13971 fixed in #13983.
  • the current session's sidebar row was hard to tell from a hovered or plain row; it now has a stronger fill and a thin outline that hovering does not override. Refs #13972 fixed in #13975.
  • the composer's Git indicator now shares its neighbours' font and line height, so it stays level with them at larger interface text. Refs #13982 fixed in #14000 by @lancy69.
  • Studio computer use waits for driver readiness on initial launch and restart after interruption, preventing intermittent startup failures. Refs #13985 by @SivanCola.
  • when a server refuses sftp (e.g. a Synology NAS), the remote folder picker, connect and remote test now use the plain command channel. #13981, #13987
  • when an Agent preset reports that its required resources are unavailable, the message now names the module (such as tools:xxx) and the reason instead of a generic sentence. Refs #13988.
  • after opening a file from a link in the conversation and closing it, pressing Files reopened that file instead of showing the file tree. Refs #13993.
  • session history search indexes what the user said, not the host-prepended language, date and project blocks, so a hit can no longer come from words its snippet cannot show. Refs #14022 by @chuiwenwei.
  • deleted or revoked documents no longer retain stale saved text; unsaved drafts remain intact, and metadata checks no longer restart on every keystroke. Refs #14031 by @SivanCola.
  • new custom presets load skills/extensions and connect MCP on demand. Inherited permissions follow current authorized configuration. Refs #13988.

Upgrade notes

  • the history index is rebuilt once on the first launch after upgrading. Refs #14022 by @chuiwenwei.
  • existing snapshots remain supported. Live sessions use event schema 5 and archive version 3; older clients cannot execute them. Refs #13988.

Thanks to this release's contributors: @SivanCola, @lancy69, @chuiwenwei

macOS 已用 Developer ID 签名并公证，打开时不需要清除隔离属性。Windows 的窗口、内核与安装器都经 Certum 代码签名证书做了 Authenticode 签名。Linux Debian 系从 .deb 安装，Fedora、RHEL、openSUSE 等从 .rpm 安装（sudo dnf install ./ReasonixStudio-linux-amd64.rpm）。x86_64 用文件名带 amd64 的包，aarch64（统信 UOS、麒麟等）用带 arm64 的包。也提供 .AppImage（只提供下载，不会自更新；需要 FUSE 2，或用 --appimage-extract-and-run 启动）。

三个平台都能自更新：Linux 的 .deb 走自己的包（.rpm 的自更新尚未提供，请手动下载新包），Windows 运行下一个安装器，macOS 替换自身 bundle。

cua-driver-rs-v0.38.0cua-driver-rs: v0.38.0 Prerelease2026-10-21T05:26:13Z

Cua Driver 0.38.0

Summary

This release adds 1 features and includes 25 fixes.

Features

  • publish cua-sdk and the proto contract so you can build your own harness (CUA-1902). (#5532)

Fixes

  • accept the GNOME helper only from the session's Shell. (#5496) Thanks @only21mil.
  • restrict Windows launch candidates to the receipt process family. (#5561) reported by @loonghao.
  • let launch_app take the .app path that list_apps reports. (#5525) Thanks @tlq5l.
  • refuse unsafe GNOME 50+ helper startup. (#5565) reported by @1111david.
  • avoid unsafe zero-delivery retry advice for macOS web typing. (#5560) reported by @howardxie-dev.
  • scale Windows foreground scroll targets from the screenshot context. (#5567) Thanks @omoi0kane.
  • stop macOS EINVAL flake in daemon client and settle capture/menu tests on conditions. (#5558)
  • keep an ended session's master pointer until its popup menu closes. (#5254) Thanks @CMGS.
  • discover native Wayland windows in desktop snapshots. (#5368) Thanks @ceckert.
  • deliver window-only foreground hotkeys through the HID activation guard. (#5522) Thanks @abonneth.
  • report unknown tools accurately. (#5579)
  • handle Add-Type failure on non-ASCII locales. (#5581)
  • Windows list_windows omits the driver's own overlay windows. (#5566) Thanks @CMGS.
  • fix Windows selected-browser launch guidance. (#5583)
  • keep GNOME element actions inside the requested window. (#5585) Thanks @only21mil.
  • report Windows tree completeness. (#5582) Thanks @ethanblake4.
  • suspend the target GUI thread while posting a Windows click. (#5584)
  • classify DOM click effects with readback. (#5586)
  • recover rootless XWayland browser identities. (#5597)
  • retry unverified macOS window prefetches. (#5605)
  • track cursor placement explicitly. (#5603)
  • undo the GTK4 CSD inset before at-point ownership checks. (#5610) Thanks @ZIXT233.
  • verify foreground Document text insertion. (#5587) Thanks @wszkxlllll.
  • never send a Windows foreground drag to the window covering the target. (#5616) Thanks @SunkenInTime.
  • distrust the compromised eMudhra intermediates in every Cua client (CUA-1948). (#5622)

Contributors

Thanks to @1111david, @abonneth, @ceckert, @CMGS, @ethanblake4, @howardxie-dev, @loonghao, @omoi0kane, @only21mil, @SunkenInTime, @tlq5l, @wszkxlllll, @ZIXT233 for contributing to this release.

Install

macOS and Linux:

/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)"

Windows:

irm https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1 | iex

Cua Driver ships universal macOS binaries, x86_64 and arm64 Windows builds, and Linux preview builds. Release assets also include tag-pinned installer and uninstaller scripts.

Why GitHub says “Pre-release”

GitHub's label is used only to keep this monorepo's repository-wide “Latest” pointer from switching between independently released products. A plain Cua Driver SemVer is a stable release; npm and PyPI publish it on their normal stable channels, and the installers resolve the versioned cua-driver-rs-v* releases directly.

Cua Spaces 0.12.1

Better

  • A failed payment is now explained. If a card payment fails, Cua Spaces tells you and says what to do next, instead of leaving your plan looking unchanged.
  • Plain plan errors. When something is blocked by your plan, such as sharing by email or using more hours than it includes, the message now says so in simple words and points to the plan page.

cua-spaces-v0.12.0Cua Spaces v0.12.0 Stable2026-10-20T22:18:44Z

Cua Spaces 0.12.0

New

  • Your language. Cua Spaces now speaks five more languages. Pick one under Settings > Language.
  • Problems show up on the Machines page. Each computer lists its own issues, found by its health checks, so you can see what's wrong without opening a terminal. cua doctor --machine prints the same checks.
  • Clear plan dates. After you cancel, the app shows "Teams until <date>" and a Resume plan button.

Better

  • Sharing, Settings, the viewer and teleport messages are all translated.
  • Cua Driver is more reliable on Windows and Linux when clicking, dragging and typing into the right window.

Security

  • Cua now refuses certificates from two compromised eMudhra intermediates in every client.

Release notes

  • Changelog (fixes + features)
  • News (:help news in Nvim)

Install

Windows

Zip

  1. Download nvim-win64.zip (or nvim-win-arm64.zip for ARM)
  2. Extract the zip
  3. Run nvim.exe in your terminal

MSI

  1. Download nvim-win64.msi (or nvim-win-arm64.msi for ARM)
  2. Run the MSI
  3. Run nvim.exe in your terminal

Note: On Windows "Server" you may need to install vcruntime*.dll.

macOS (x86_64)

  1. Download nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz
  2. Run xattr -c ./nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
  3. Extract: tar xzvf nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz
  4. Run ./nvim-macos-x86_64/bin/nvim

macOS (arm64)

  1. Download nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz
  2. Run xattr -c ./nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
  3. Extract: tar xzvf nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz
  4. Run ./nvim-macos-arm64/bin/nvim

Linux (x86_64)

If your system does not have the required glibc version, try the (unsupported) builds for older glibc.

AppImage

  1. Download nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage
  2. Run chmod u+x nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage
    • If your system does not have FUSE you can extract the appimage:
      ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage --appimage-extract
./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim

Tarball

  1. Download nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
  2. Extract: tar xzvf nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
  3. Run ./nvim-linux-x86_64/bin/nvim

Linux (arm64)

AppImage

  1. Download nvim-linux-arm64.appimage
  2. Run chmod u+x nvim-linux-arm64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage
    • If your system does not have FUSE you can extract the appimage:
      ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage --appimage-extract
./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim

Tarball

  1. Download nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz
  2. Extract: tar xzvf nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz
  3. Run ./nvim-linux-arm64/bin/nvim

v18.12.5 Stable2026-10-21T02:31:29Z

@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Added

  • Added OpenAI 12-hour prompt caching for GPT-5.6+ on the Responses API: cacheRetention: "long" now requests prompt_cache_options.ttl: "12h" (instead of the ignored legacy prompt_cache_retention: "24h"), and promptCache.ttl accepts "12h"

Fixed

  • Fixed every OpenAI Codex request failing with HTTP 404 {"detail":"Not Found"} on personal ChatGPT accounts whose token is not region-pinned (#16493)

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Fixed

  • Fixed Moonshot kimi-k3 pricing cache writes at $0; usage cost now includes cache writes at Moonshot's $3/M 5-minute rate (#16508)

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Added

  • providers.cacheRetention: long now keeps OpenAI GPT-5.6+ prompt caches for 12 hours (Responses API; cache writes cost 2.5× input instead of 1.25×)

Fixed

  • Fixed subagents spawning at a caller-supplied effort (e.g. hi → max) while task.enableEffort is off; the field is now ignored and the agent's configured thinking level (including :auto) applies (#16402)
  • Fixed omp update --check failing against JFrog Artifactory registries that add empty dist-tags to a tagged manifest; the update check now uses the registry's curated latest version (#16375)
  • Fixed <path>:conflicts on a file past the 10 MiB scan cap reporting no conflicts with no hint: it now names the line the scan stopped at and the ranged read that registers the blocks after it (#16269)
  • Fixed the ts-set-map rule stalling tool-call streaming for seconds on a long single-line Map literal, and missing Map entries written ["key", value] as const (#16242)
  • Fixed the ts-import-type rule missing inline type imports whose member name is non-ASCII, such as import("./units").温度 (#16242)

@oh-my-pi/pi-natives

Fixed

  • Fixed a macOS background action leaving its target in front of your app after you clicked another of your windows, when placing the click took longer than the click itself (#16217)

What's Changed

  • fix(update): handled empty Artifactory dist-tags on tagged manifests by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16379
  • fix(task): ignored caller effort while task.enableEffort is off by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16406
  • fix(catalog): stopped declaring no_constraint codex residency by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16501
  • fix(catalog): priced moonshot kimi-k3 cache writes at the 5min rate by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16529

Full Changelog: https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/compare/v18.12.4...v18.12.5
